subject.title: feat(cron): emit session.maintenance.pruned diagnostic event on reaper pruning

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `session.maintenance.pruned` and these exact OpenTelemetry and Prometheus metric names as a supported diagnostics contract?
rationale: The code can implement the event mechanically, but automation cannot decide whether this new discriminated-union member and its metric names are the permanent public observability taxonomy.

options.title: Adopt the count-only contract
options.body: Approve the current event and metric names after real Gateway exporter proof confirms the complete path.

options.title: Use a generic maintenance event
options.body: Pause this PR and define a broader session-maintenance event shape before exposing a permanent contract.

options.title: Keep log-only behavior
options.body: Decline the new structured telemetry surface and leave the existing informational log as the supported signal.

recommendation.title: Adopt the count-only contract
recommendation.body: Approve the current event and metric names after real Gateway exporter proof confirms the complete path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate connected to the gateway diagnostics and plugin surface affected by this contract.
